why: 16:52-1:06:40 (~50 of 65 min) is a review of the tool words (awal, taani, 8eir, aghlab, nafs, aa5er) with idafa and pronouns - 17:03 'tell me what do you know about أول؟', 15:51 'we agreed for you to review their function words' - plus one new twist at 17:49-21:36, 'my first time' = 'أول مرة إلي' (18:58 'There's two ways to say my first, my second, my last'), drilled as شنطتها الأخيرة / آخر شنطة إلها (32:34, 33:43) and كاستها التانية (39:50). 02:26-15:38 is warm-up talk in Arabic (homework, a lazy day, the saying العمر بيخلص والشغل ما بيخلص, the election, clothes); 1:03-1:06 he talks about his Spanish.

taught_words.english: as much as (مش أد = not as much as), not عادي
life ends but work never does (a saying)
the day before yesterday (= قبل مبارح)
last month (the past month); قبل شهر = a month ago

summary.headline: Tool word review (awal, taani, 8eir, aghlab, nafs, aa5er) + new: my first / my last with إلي

rules.title: my first / my last: أول مرة إلي, not مرتي الأولى
rules.pattern: awal / aa5er / taani + noun + إلي (or إلها, إلهم...)
bullets: مرتي sounds like 'my wife', so say أول مرة إلي
the pronoun goes on إلي, not on the noun
only مفضل takes عندي; the rest take إلي

examples.line: أول مرة إلي - my first time
آخر شنطة إلها - her last bag
تانية كاسة إلها - her second cup

rules.title: or put the pronoun on the noun and use the adjective with el-: شنطتها الأخيرة
rules.pattern: noun + pronoun + el- + adjective (الأولى / التانية / الأخيرة)
bullets: أول شنطتها means 'the beginning of her bag'
a noun with a pronoun is definite, like el-
so the ordinal follows as an adjective

rules.title: awal / aa5er + noun or pronoun = the beginning / the end of it
bullets: no من: awal il-hafla = the beginning of the party
آخر برنامجنا = the end of our program
آخر مرة = the last time (no el-)

examples.line: awal il hafla - the beginning of the party
آخر برنامجنا - the end of our program
آخر مرة بعملها - the last time I do it

rules.title: nafs il-ishi: nafs always takes el-
bullets: people say nafs ishi, but the L is there
nafs il makan - the same place

examples.line: nafs il ishi - the same thing
نفس أجوبتك - the same as your answers
inti ghayr 3an il kul - you're different from everyone

rules.title: aghlab el-wa'it, not aghlab el-marra
bullets: مرة is one occurrence, so not with aghlab
aghlab + pronoun: aghlabhum = most of them

examples.line: أغلب الوقت - most of the time
أغلب أسئلتك - most of your questions
